note: This release records source and license readiness only. It does not promote unconfigured enrichment sources into scientific coverage.

adapters.versionPolicy: Pin the source URL, capture timestamp, last-modified value and digest.
adapters.limitation: Registry membership is not a substitute for application, product or active-moiety linkage.

adapters.licenseName: NCBI database policy; submitter rights may vary
adapters.versionPolicy: Pin CID, InChIKey, request URL, capture timestamp and asset digest.
adapters.limitation: NCBI cannot grant rights it does not hold in third-party submissions; redistribution remains reviewable.

adapters.versionPolicy: Enable only with a dated target snapshot and deterministic identity join report.
adapters.limitation: No target snapshot is checked in for the current release.

adapters.versionPolicy: Pin a ChEMBL release and preserve assay, species, unit and document identifiers.
adapters.limitation: Cross-assay values are not directly comparable without matched conditions.

adapters.versionPolicy: Use a numbered download release; do not depend on browser-time REST access.
adapters.limitation: The API is transitioning to registered API-key access; no versioned snapshot is checked in.

adapters.licenseName: Label content may retain manufacturer copyright
adapters.versionPolicy: Pin SPL set/version and section locator; retain short structured fields, not copied label prose.
adapters.limitation: DailyMed notes that in-use labeling may differ from the latest FDA-approved labeling.

adapters.versionPolicy: Pin export date and SPL identifiers; parse only explicitly mapped sections.
adapters.limitation: openFDA warns that records are not validated for clinical or production use.

adapters.licenseName: Copyright — attribution required; no commercial copying or modification
adapters.versionPolicy: Do not package an ATC hierarchy until a compatible permission or licensed source is recorded.
adapters.limitation: Public-repository redistribution and translated hierarchy generation require a separate rights decision.

adapters.versionPolicy: Pin a release/export and limit requests to the published service rate.
adapters.limitation: Pharmacogenomic guidance is not direct diagnostic advice and needs its own reviewed presentation.

adapters.versionPolicy: Pin a download release and keep measurement, target, species and source-document context.
adapters.limitation: Only BindingDB-curated fields covered by the stated license may be promoted.
